name: frank — ops
postCreateCommand: git config --global --add safe.directory "$PWD" || true; uv tool install --python 3.13 'git+https://github.com/derio-net/super-fr#subdirectory=packages/fr'

fr.purpose: DevOps stage (fr ops gate): the manual operations of a gated PR. Credentials: GH_TOKEN (merge, gate labels) and KUBECONFIG_B64 (SubjectAccessReviews, RoleBinding deletes, Authentik exec) only; add more per run, never preemptively
